user.title: Add a lighting curve
user.description: Name the schedule (for example the room). Choose its lights and edit its curve with the Lighting Curves dashboard card.

abort.already_configured: A schedule with this name already exists.

init.title: Light control
init.description: Lights follow the curve while on. Manual changes pause adaptation; turning a light off and on resumes it. A manual control timeout of 0 disables automatic resumption.
